speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) of prematurity. The clinical presentation of tachypnea, retractions, and cyanosis in a 32-week preterm infant, combined with chest X-ray findings of a ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms, is classic for RDS due to surfactant deficiency.
